name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Huh? You two've only been here once? Oh, I see. Sure, okay."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... No dice. You didn't see her, yeah? Yup, she ain't here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, it is what it is. Let's hit our next spot."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No way you're picking that up, you're unreal. That thing's already giving me the creeps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it? It's like... the same vibe as when you bump into a ghost. Kinda like that, but not at the same time. You get me? Nope?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Point is, it's some kinda occult thing. I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Spirited away, huh... You think it's connected? 'Cause I have no idea."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe that occult girl would know. This kinda stuff's her specialty, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If you're curious, why not ask her? I don't really care either way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, up to you. For now, why not just take it? C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You could just take it for now. Who knows, maybe some occult nut's gonna pay good money for it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If it sells, let's split—Wait, never mind. Money's useless to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, do whatever you want. C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah~... This again. Looks like we found another one."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Seriously what are these things? They're definitely not normal... It'd be hilarious if they turned out to be just toys, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, might as well pick it up."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, an OOPArt. What're ya waiting for? Pick it up~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What even are these? They're, like... a big deal, right? I've heard of them before, I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I might not look like it, but I'm actually pretty into video games. I'm kinda getting pumped."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's all of them, yeah? Let's take 'em back to the occult girl and have her make us a legendary sword~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Let's hurry up and find the rest so we can trade 'em in for the legendary sword~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, let's go then. C'mon, time to get a move on."
